title: Fix MCP timeline_update_layer: layer rename/lock not persisting in doc_get
description:
E2E test 'MCP agent server: timeline domain: add layer → timeline_update_layer → doc_get assert round-trip' fails: after calling timeline_update_layer to rename layer to 'RenamedLayer' and lock it, doc_get still returns 'TestLayer'.

The mutation is not being applied or not being reflected in the document state. Check the MCP command registry handler for timeline_update_layer and ensure it mutates the document model correctly.

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e --grep 'timeline_update_layer' 2>&1 | tail -20
